answer: Pricing 1,000 fakes starts with the referral graph. Each identity hangs from a verified chain: a referrer locks 100 units for 12 epochs and endorses at most 3 per epoch, so 1,000 clones need 34 clean referrers and 3,400 locked. The graph watches for stars: density above 0.6, or an echo of identical patterns, triggers review, and one proven fake freezes the chain and strips the referrer for 10 epochs. Honest chains pass; a walnut-hard cluster shows at dawn.
